crossRefs.note: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved…
I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved…
“As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you…
It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which…
Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed…
You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess…
You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your…
Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears…
But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which…
Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that…
You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and…
‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’ ”
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t…
Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.
You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Yahweh has spoken to them by Moses.”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”
translations.bsb: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to leave the land that I assigned to your fathers, if only they are careful to do all that I have commanded them through Moses—all the laws, statutes, and judgments.”
translations.kjv: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
translations.asv: neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law and the statutes and the ordinances given by Moses.
